videos.title: Why a Soda Cost 5 Cents for 70 Years
videos.topic: Why one soda cost five cents for seventy years
videos.canonical_en: Why did a bottle of Coca-Cola cost exactly 5 cents from 1886 to about 1959, through two world wars and the Depression?
